units.source_text: "逢佛杀佛，逢祖杀祖，逢罗汉杀罗汉，逢父母杀父母，逢亲眷杀亲眷，始能获得解脱。

en.t: "When you meet the Buddha, kill the Buddha; when you meet the patriarchs, kill the patriarchs; when you meet an arhat, kill the arhat; when you meet your parents, kill your parents; when you meet your relatives, kill your relatives. Only then can you attain liberation.
Be bound by nothing, and move freely with complete ease."
